comment: SALONART -> LEVEL, 2026-11-07. Everything as plate fractions of assets/art/salon/salon-room.png (832x1248, the clean plate from accepted 991002). Camera refit to the paint: tool/art/rooms/salon.json. Proposals; LEVEL may move marks, but keep them inside 'floor'.

floorCamera.note: Standing adult height at foot y = (y - 0.27) / 1.0, as a fraction of plate height. Mācron at heroHome is 45 logical px (garden 38, billiards 38).

floor.note: Hand-traced on the plate. Left of x .385 between y .40 and .58 is the dais (top y .40-.465, front face down to .575). The far wall's foot is y .38; the doors are x .42-.60.

exit.note: Mācron walks up the centre joint to the double doors. Their leaves are x .42-.60, top .187, foot .38. He'd be about 0.12 of plate height tall there in floor terms; at the threshold he passes behind nothing.

guests.note: Couples dance on the right side and at the back; the left side is the dais and the trio. Couples are .42 adult apart (GUESTS' reach). All behind the challenger's mark. Reusing guest3-6 in evening wear (amber gold dress, lavender shirt and bow tie, plum wrap dress, amber jacket), the party's casting.
guests.rejected: Tried on a staging proof: a pair at y .56 on the right (in front of Don's line, and huge at the phone's edge) and a pair at y .395 in front of the left door leaf (read as standing on the dais beside the violinist). Both dropped.

trio.note: On the dais top, no platform lift: the painted dais and piano are drawn at about the floor's scale at their image y, so size the players by the floor plane at their feet (stature 1). Ladder: copy cool-crowd's 'instrument' ladder (relaxed / tap / swing frames). The pianist sits in the plate's own bench; her atlas is 1:1 with the plate at those feet.

players.note: feet are her anchor on the plate (110, 562 px); don't move her or she leaves her bench

occluders.note: The piano is painted behind every trio player and nobody stands behind it, so no occluder is needed. If a guest is ever placed behind the dais, use this:

layers.note: block written by tool/art/rooms/layers.py frames to art_runs/rooms/salon/layers-level.json; copy its 'layers' into the level

glow.note: Chandelier centres (the candle ring) for the outro's flare; the four wall sconces beside the windows and doors.
